report_guidance:
Approved report names (edit the bold names in this list):
No approved report names are configured in General. Add the names appropriate to your practice as - **Name** entries. Until then, leave report names empty; documents remain available under provisional labels.

Use only an approved name supported by a prominent heading on the supplied page. Do not infer a title from an incidental mention or footer alone. If no approved name matches, leave the name empty rather than inventing it.

Extract the report's own date even if its name is unresolved. Distinguish it from filing, service and printing dates. Leave an unresolved date empty.
form_guidance:
Approved form names (edit the bold names in this list):
No approved form names are configured in General. Add the names appropriate to your practice as - **Name** entries. You may append matching requirements after an em dash, such as the required heading and form code. Until then, leave form names empty; documents remain available under provisional labels.

Use only an approved name supported by a prominent heading on the supplied page. If an entry requires a form code, both the required heading and code must be visible on that same page. Do not infer a name from an incidental reference to another document. If no entry matches, leave the name empty rather than guessing.
